```yaml
architecture:
  style: nestjs
  layers:
    - name: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/app/database/**
        - src/app/redis/**
      file_patterns:

      roles:
        - repository-impl
        - external-service
    - name: application
      directories:
        - src/app/**/models/**
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.service.ts"
        - "**/*.dto.ts"
      roles:
        - application-service
        - dto
    - name: presentation
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.controller.ts"
        - "**/*.module.ts"
        - "**/*.guard.ts"
      roles:
        - controller
        - module
        - guard
      decorators:
        - "@Controller"
        - "@Module"
```
